note: Any-site Jev template — copy, replace URL/criteria, keep same 3 patterns. Run: node browser-tester/scripts/scenario.mjs browser-tester/scenarios/any-site-jev.json --report

criteria.form: Page contains a form with inputs and a submit button ready to fill
criteria.listing: Page is a listing or search results page with many links
criteria.article: Page is primarily article/content reading with little interaction

criteria: Form present but missing fields or disabled
Form ready to fill - inputs visible and enabled
Fully ready - all fields fillable and submit enabled

safeToFill.criteria: It is safe to fill the form - inputs are visible, enabled, and not a phishing or error page

filled.criteria: The form fields were filled and retain the typed values

criteria.submit: Ready to submit the form - values look valid
criteria.review: Need human review - values missing or page shows error
criteria.abort: Should abort - page is wrong or unsafe
